cases.issue: Detergent remains in the dispenser after a wash.

response.text: Check that items in the baskets do not prevent the detergent dispenser lid from opening.
response.title: Clear the detergent dispenser lid

cases.issue: Removable white streaks remain on glasses after a wash.

response.text: If the detergent quantity is too high, use the correct amount stated on its packaging.
response.title: Check the detergent quantity

cases.issue: There is an unpleasant odour inside the dishwasher.

response.text: Before maintenance, deactivate and unplug the appliance. Carefully clean the interior and door gasket with a soft damp cloth; avoid abrasive products and strong chemicals.
response.title: Clean the appliance interior

cases.issue: The dishwasher will not start because the door will not close securely.

response.text: Close the appliance door fully before trying to start the programme.
response.title: Close the appliance door

cases.issue: There is a rattling noise during the wash.

response.text: This exact model has no verified noise guidance in the current reference catalog. No check was selected. Keep the report in the handover for a qualified service conversation.
